Finalizes a user registration with the token that they were issued in their
registration email
.. example::
$ curl http://localhost:5000/confirmation -X GET          -H "Authorization: Bearer <your_token>"

Refreshes an existing JWT by creating a new one that is a copy of the old
except that it has a refreshed access expiration.
.. example::
$ curl http://localhost:5000/refresh -X GET          -H "Authorization: Bearer <your_token>"
